items.title: 67247_J.C. Higginbotham oral history interview
items.q: [INTERVIEWER] In bands which would you say - when they say the King of Swing, they're also saying that his band was the best band and the swingingest band of the 30's. Is that so?

ctx.x: You mean the King of Swing as of now?
That's the way it reads in the history books.

items.title: 67247_J.C. Higginbotham oral history interview
items.q: [INTERVIEWER] What was your impression of people like Paul Whiteman and Benny Goodman? ... [(note)] I think he's very nice.

ctx.x: I don't know. We went out I think for more than a year ... with Lucky's band.
What was your impression of people like Paul Whiteman and Benny Goodman?
